descriptions.description: COMMENT Excluded from Algeria. It was reported byJelenc (1955 a) from Tassili n’Adrar, point d’eau Tig Hert, à l’ouest de Tamada, 600 m, but in the Addenda of the publication, the author rectified the identification to Vesicularia reimersiana Bizot & P. de la Varde.
